<function name="SavePresets" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
<internal></internal>

Overwrites all presets with the supplied table. Used by the <page>presets</page> for preset saving</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="presets" type="table">Presets to be saved</arg>
	</args>
</function>
